notes.title: V19 The Island Update is out!
notes.content:
3 new weapons (Ukulele, banana gun, and coconut cannon)
1 new area (The Island, found in the second town)
Bug fixes! (No more unplayable levels, ever!)
More sounds
Spell and health potion changes!


Looking for feedback! Also, big plans for the next update which has already started development!
